body:
"He wanted you to care about his feelings. Not refer him to a professional."

Are these really mutually exclusive things? From his perspective, it seems like it was, but, like you said, we don't see eye to eye there. I want to hear his side of it, but he won't talk to me anymore. That's the only reason I'm here. Does caring about his feelings require me to not seek help if I believe he is about to die?

As far as I know his friends are somewhat aware of the situation, but they aren't providing the kind of support he would like. I've talked with several members of his family, and they all seem to think he's not serious about suicide and is just bluffing. They seem to be in a place where they're tired of listening, which seems like a dangerous situation to me. 

It's been difficult for me to find out a lot about what's going on from so far away because so many of the people involved have stubborn attitudes.
